description: Runs tasks.json and launch.json files written for the Microsoft C/C++ extension: cppbuild tasks, the $gcc problem matcher and cppdbg/cppvsdbg launch configurations (debugged with CodeLLDB).
cppbuild.command.description: The path to the compiler or the command to run.
cppbuild.args.description: Arguments passed to the compiler or command.
cppbuild.args.quoting.description: How the argument value is quoted.
cppbuild.args.quoting.escape.description: Escape characters using the shell's escape character (for example ` under PowerShell and \ under bash).
cppbuild.args.quoting.strong.description: Quote the argument using the shell's strong quote character (for example ' under PowerShell and bash).
cppbuild.args.quoting.weak.description: Quote the argument using the shell's weak quote character (for example " under PowerShell and bash).
cppbuild.options.cwd.description: The current working directory of the command. Defaults to the workspace folder.
cppbuild.options.env.description: Additional environment variables for the command.
cppbuild.options.shell.description: The shell used to run the command line.
cppbuild.problemMatcher.description: The problem matcher(s) to use. Defaults to $gcc, or $msCompile for cl.exe.
cppbuild.windows.description: Windows-specific overrides of command, args, options and problemMatcher.
cppbuild.linux.description: Linux-specific overrides of command, args, options and problemMatcher.
cppbuild.osx.description: macOS-specific overrides of command, args, options and problemMatcher.
cppdbg.program.description: Full path to the program executable.
cppdbg.args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.
cppdbg.cwd.description: The working directory of the program.
cppdbg.environment.description: Environment variables added to the environment of the program, as a list of name/value pairs.
cppdbg.envFile.description: Path to a file containing environment variable definitions.
cppdbg.stopAtEntry.description: Stop at the start of main.
cppdbg.externalConsole.description: Launch the program in an external console.
cppvsdbg.console.description: Where to launch the program: the debug console, the integrated terminal or an external terminal.
cppdbg.sourceFileMap.description: Source file mappings from build paths to local paths.
cppdbg.setupCommands.description: Commands run when the debugger starts. Only LLDB command line commands are used (when MIMode is lldb); GDB and MI commands are skipped.
cppdbg.MIMode.description: The debugger the configuration was written for. Debugging always uses CodeLLDB; this only decides whether setupCommands can be used.
cppdbg.miDebuggerServerAddress.descripti: Address of a gdbserver compatible debug server to connect to (host:port).
cppdbg.coreDumpPath.description: Path to a core dump to debug.
cppvsdbg.dumpPath.description: Path to a dump file to debug.
cppdbg.additionalSOLibSearchPath.descrip: Semicolon separated list of directories to search for shared libraries.
cppvsdbg.symbolSearchPath.description: Semicolon separated list of directories to search for symbol files.
cppdbg.processId.description: The id of the process to attach to.
cppdbg.ignored.description: Specific to the Microsoft C/C++ extension's debugger. Ignored when debugging with CodeLLDB.
cppdbg.rejected.description: Not supported without the Microsoft C/C++ extension. Debugging this configuration with CodeLLDB is refused.
problemMatcher.gcc.label: GCC and Clang compiler problems
problemMatcher.iar.label: IAR compiler problems
problemMatcher.armcc5.label: ARM Compiler 5 problems
